description: This file defines a React component 'PathwayClient' that serves as a UI page for exploring different career pathways. It includes UI elements like tabs, cards, buttons, and handles navigation to an 'Explore' page with specific query parameters based on user selections. It also provides information about various path types ('vertical', 'lateral', 'pivot', 'non_linear') and their descriptions.

methods.name: multiverseLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given 'multiverse' path type.

methods.name: multiverseDescription
methods.description: Provides a descriptive explanation for each 'multiverse' path type.
